source: Google reviews - Sprouts Academy Tutoring Gregory Hills, NSW (business continuing as TutorMunk)

reviews.name: Natalie Vitale
reviews.text: Many thanks to sprouts academy and tutor Varsha for all the help and guidance with my daughter. They have been extremely kind, helpful and professional at all times.

reviews.name: Chirag Kukreja
reviews.text: We have been with Sprouts Academy for a few weeks now after our 10yr old daughter felt she was struggling to comprehend some aspects of maths in school. We also felt tutoring would be a good way to fill any gaps that home schooling during COVID may have created. Her tutor has been great, making our daughter feel comfortable and focusing on the areas where she needs the most help. We get in-depth summary reports after every session so we know exactly where our daughters learning is currently sitting. A highly recommended tutoring company. Great work - Sprouts Academy!

reviews.name: Palvinder Singh
reviews.text: We started with Sprouts Academy for our son in term 2 this year for English and Mathematics coaching. The tutors at Sprouts are amazing educators. They were able to explain things so easily, and my son gained so much confidence. His school teacher also praised him for his academic improvement. I can without a doubt recommend Sprouts Academy to all the parents whose child is struggling with Mathematics or English!

reviews.name: Tanuj Sharma
reviews.text: We're had a great experience so far with Sprouts Academy. Our son is very engaged with the teacher and implementing his learning at school which is awesome! Sprouts Academy is better than many bigger tutoring companies, highly recommend Sprouts Academy!

reviews.name: Nikhil Bhat
reviews.text:
The attention to detail is mind blowing. They are building the future of Australia.

I find the tutors to be very understanding of the children's capabilities of their learning. My daughter has really gained knowledge from her sessions and admitted she enjoys interacting with her tutor. Sprouts Academy provides individual attention to each and every child. Very happy with the service.

reviews.name: Maha katta
reviews.text:
My son started going to Sprouts in term 2. I am so happy with his progress. Teachers has provided individual attention and customised the teaching techniques as per my child’s requirements. Can’t thank enough to Sprouts Academy. Strongly recommend to anyone.
Maha

reviews.name: mIzHeRsHe Ehsrehzim
reviews.text: We were very unhappy and disappointed with our previous tutoring school but with Sprouts Academy we couldn't be happier and pleased with their service, flexibility, great communication, friendly and professional staff. It's great that they offer face to face and one on one tutoring which i think my son benefits from the most than online learning or group session. Their fees are affordable and the fact they keep the same tutor means consistency, and that is very important with my son or else he gets confused and loses interest. Our son loves his tutors style of teaching, and we also like that he gets homework to practice on! From being negative towards tutoring at the start he now looks forward to his tutoring session with confidence. We can't highly recommend Sprouts Academy enough!

reviews.name: Wendy Milojkovic
reviews.text: My son has greatly improved in Maths thanks to the dedicated and professional staff.  I highly recommend Sprouts Academy to any parent that has a child struggling in Maths and English.  The staff focused on my son's individual needs and provided support and direction that in effect has given my son the confidence and discipline that he lacked.

reviews.name: Elizabeth Mizyed
reviews.text: I highly recommend sprouts academy if you are considering hiring a tutor. My children started this year with a maths tutor and I could not be happier with the level and quality of service. My children were initially apprehensive at the thought of starting tutoring but were instantly at ease after the first lesson and excited to continue! Sprouts really cares about teaching and this is obvious in the way they deal with their clients. My only regret is that I wish I contacted them earlier!!!

reviews.name: Harpreet Narula
reviews.text: We first started with Sprouts Academy in Term 2 this year and since then there has been no looking back. My kids have shown so much improvement. Tutors really make sure that kids understand the concepts. Highly recommend Sprouts Academy!

reviews.name: Vinay Yadav
reviews.text: Tutors at Sprouts academy are highly knowledgeable and work hard to ensure success. Sprouts Academy as a company strives to improves students learning abilities. excellent tutoring service. I have no hesitation in recommending Sprouts Academy for all your tutoring needs.

reviews.name: Rishu Dhawan
reviews.text: Staff at Sprouts Academy is absolutely great! Tutors ensure that kids learn the concepts in a correct manner which encourages a them to gain confidence. I have no hesitations in recommending Sprouts Academy for tutoring

reviews.name: Hitarth Jani
reviews.text: Sprouts Academy has been very accommodative.  We were not very sure if our son would like one on one tutoring. The tutor is very patient and listens to the queries and gives solutions kindly. We are very happy with progress in our childs studies.

reviews.name: Hala Noreen
reviews.text: I admire the exceptional commitment showcased by Sprouts Academy. The level of professionalism and dedication displayed by the team is truly remarkable. The personalised approach to tutoring ensures that every student receives the individual attention they need to excel. The presence of open communication and an inclusive environment cultivates a constructive and collaborative atmosphere for learning. I wholeheartedly recommend Sprouts Academy for their unwavering commitment to student growth and development.

reviews.name: John Adeyemi
reviews.text: Sprout Academy is top notch study centre. I have seen great improvement in the academic performance of my son, particularly in his Maths. The tutors are friendly and make the learning enjoyable for students. He comes home with home work that gets him occupied through out the week. The centre is highly recommended.

reviews.name: savita sharma
reviews.text: Sprouts Academy is the perfect approach to ensure our child has no gaps in her learning, and more importantly, is extended to reach her academic potential - something we feared was not being fulfilled for her at school. The one-hour, face to face offline tutoring with a highly experienced tutor in English, and in Math, are fantastic. We receive reports immediately after each tutorial, to consolidate learning skills. There are no lock-in contracts, it is flexible, and you can change tutors, times, and catch up on missed lessons within the week. I couldn't recommend Sprouts Academy more highly.

reviews.name: kellie lopez
reviews.text:
I highly recommend Sprouts Academy. We have been extremely happy with the service, communication and knowledge of both the admin staff and tutor.

When we suggested a tutor, our son wasn’t exactly over the moon. A couple sessions later, he’d be sitting at the desk awaiting the tutors arrival. Our son has benefited greatly from learning with his tutor as he always feels encouraged, reassured and motivated. There is a significant difference between being told you’re wrong, and being shown a learning style that pushes you until you find the right answer. Our son feels accomplished after each session and I highly recommend Sprouts Academy.

reviews.name: Manish Shaw
reviews.text: Sprouts Academy is highly recommended by me because education is taken very seriously here. Teachers make sure that the concept is understood by the child so that the homework can be done independently. The homework gets checked and mistakes are explained too. My daughter  enjoys going there and is showing increasing confidence and interest in her studies.

reviews.name: Raheel Irfan
reviews.text: My two boys goes to Sprout academy. Their service are good and kids enjoy going there. My kids have improved a lot as well since they started this private tuition with sprout. Tuition fee is economical as well for two subjects.

reviews.name: Eleonora Molina
reviews.text: Ms Anne has been tutoring my two primary-aged children in mathematics for the past 12 months. She is both engaging and nurturing, making maths fun and accessible for my children. She uses a variety of teaching methods, including interactive games and practical exercises, which have significantly improved their understanding and retention of key concepts. My children now look forward to their tutoring sessions each week. Thank you Ms Anne.

reviews.name: sdny Dhillon
reviews.text: Sprouts Academy is highly recommended for Maths/English tuitions! Tutors at Sprouts Academy are well qualified and ensure that kids learn in a safe environment! They make learning fun so the students enjoy the subjects.

reviews.text: Sprouts Academy have been very supportive got a great tutor in short notice My daughters look forward to their session every week. Highly recommend them.

Special shout out to Mrs Anne Mathew, our math tutor, with wealth of knowledge and strong communication skills and ability to tailor the session in a way that best suits my child.  We know Mrs Mathew for quite sometime now. She is very understanding of my daughter's needs and extremely accommodating.
We highly recommend her 🌹

reviews.name: tahera banu
reviews.text: Teachers at Sprouts Academy are very professional and helpful at the same time. My kids enjoy the lessons and want to do more. I am happy to recommend Sprouts Academy for tutoring!

reviews.name: Prachi Pahwa
reviews.text: The Sprouts Academy team is highly motivated and positive about transforming tutoring across Sydney. Working with them has been an incredible experience. I was always encouraged to think out of the box and deliver ideas that were crucial for their endeavour.

Great customer care and instant respond to customer queries,
Very helpful and give great advice based on child needs and help parents and child to achieve their potential goals in studying successfully.
Showing great understanding and ability to provide studying skills and learning opportunities to reach higher score levels.
That’s the mutual goal between the tutor and my child.
I am glad that my child was offered this opportunity to have one of the great tutor.

reviews.name: Lele Williams
reviews.text: Highly recommended, super professional and fantastically with my kids. Great communication and also willing to move things around to suit family needs. My children’s have really exceeded in their education since starting with sprouts. I wouldn’t go anywhere else. Very impressed with the work set out for my kids to complete.

reviews.name: pawandeep kaur
reviews.text: The Sprouts Academy is a wonderful organisation that helps children gain their confidence towards  learning. The team/staff are very kind and professional, I’m very pleased to be apart of their journey!!!..

reviews.name: Amitosh Srivastava
reviews.text: Sprouts Academy is highly recommended for Mathematics/English tuition's. Teachers at Sprouts Academy are well qualified and they ensure that kids learn in a safe environment.

reviews.name: Natasha Makdasy
reviews.text: Sprouts have been excellent in Maths for my son this year. Building up his confidence and actually enjoying going to tutoring. Would highly recommend

reviews.name: Saumya Srivastava
reviews.text: The tutors are knowledgeable, kind and thorough. As far as I can tell, they are trained education professional - not your average slightly-older student that would help a bit with homework, but rather a professional with a methodological curriculum plan. Harjot, the center coordinator ensures every child is given individual attention. Highly recommend Sprouts Academy!

reviews.name: Jeffrey Sphabmixai
reviews.text: We have been very impressed with the professionalism of Sprouts in Oran Park. The tutors dedicate the time to ensure our kids understand a topic completely before moving on to the next thing. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ritu Chhabra
reviews.text: My 16 year old daughter was struggling with chemistry and in 3 sessions with her tutor her confidence and understanding of the subject has expanded to the point that her recent test did not provoke any anxiety. The cost for tutoring is definitely affordable. The tutor is conscientious, prompt and friendly. I like that there are no lock-in fees or conditions - the flexibility of this service is really customer driven. When I first rang and enquired I had lots of questions and Inde answered all with honesty and patience. Fantastic investment in my child’s education. Thank you Inde and Sprouts Academy, can’t sing your praises enough!

reviews.name: Kaylee White
reviews.text: I got in contact to organise tutoring for my son. Once I was contacted and advised of the cost $72per hour I asked if it could be fortnightly as I can’t afford that weekly. I was told that was fine. After a number of calls to find a suitable time and availability I was booked in. Only to be called back again to say that they don’t accept fortnightly sessions with the reason being that they don’t see improvement in the child. I don’t have the money to pay this amount weekly, I am not able to help my son with year 11 maths so surely fortnightly sessions is better than nothing? I am really disappointed with the outcome and I don’t think $72 extra a week is easily affordable.

reviews.name: Shannon
reviews.text:
Very happy with the dedication give to my child by the tutor
We have noticed a huge improvement in our child's school work.
Spelling, maths and creativity. thanks again Sprouts looking forward to enrolling my next child to travel the same road to success.

reviews.text: I am a Year 9 student and I received a 'B' grade for Mathematics for Semester 1 2020.  My parents are very happy, as I worked very hard in the last  18 months with Sprouts Academy and progressed from being a 'D' grade student.  Thank you Inderpreet and Soofia for your efforts.

reviews.name: Bradley Cagauan
reviews.text: Excellent tutoring service provider. Tutors are well-equipped and able to create tailor-made, personalised lessons for a diverse range of student needs. The team is responsive and receptive to customer feedback. Highly recommended for all students of all levels.
